app.notes: Health Connect: in Settings → Health, connect the app to share your workouts, weight and body fat with Samsung Health, Google Fit, Fitbit and other apps, and see heart rate from your watch on each workout, weigh-ins from a smart scale and your daily steps. Needs Android 8 or newer.

es.notes: Health Connect: en Ajustes → Salud, conecta la app para compartir tus entrenamientos, peso y grasa corporal con Samsung Health, Google Fit, Fitbit y otras apps, y ver el pulso de tu reloj en cada entrenamiento, los pesajes de una báscula inteligente y tus pasos diarios. Necesita Android 8 o posterior.
